Disappointment at Boomerang
Sep 2019 • Friends
I have visited a few times at Boomerand restaurant. To be honest their food is mediocre, for example the pizza and salad, but we have been returning because of the lovely view and ambience. However the last visit was a shocker. I arrived without reservation and apologised. There were only 2 tables available - a table for 2 in a great position and a table for 2 at the back. I asked if the 2 of us could have the table for 2 in the great position but was told it was reserved even though there was no reserved sign. I asked when the customers would arrive and was told that it would be in one hour. I asked if I could use the table until then but they said no so I settled for the out of the way table for two. About 10 minutes later a Vietnamese lady and her partner arrived and asked if they could use the table and they were told yes!!! 5 minutes later the waiter came over to my table for 2 and tried to take my friend's chair (the friend had not yet arrived). I explained that the chair was for my friend but he said that he knew that but the Vietnamese lady who had arrived on the reserved table needed a chair for her handbag and shopping bags!!! In retrospect I should have walked out then at their offensive treatment but I said that not only had they given the table they refused me to another customer but now they expected me to give up my guest's chair for the same customer!!! I told the waiter it was extremely bad service and to leave my guest's chair alone. He disappeared. My friend who is Vietnamese arrived shortly after and I didn't mention any of this not to spoil our meeting. The waiter came to take our order and my friend ordered the steak dish. After the waiter took our order I realised he hadn't asked my friend how he liked his steak cooked. I asked my friend and he said well done. I beckoned the waiter over and told him that he had forgotten to ask my friend how he wanted his steak cooked. His answer was outrageous and if I was the manager I would have fired him. I did ask for the manager after the meal but was told he was unavailable. The waiter told me that 'He's Vietnamese. We don't ask because Vietnamese eat anything .' Although I was completely shocked I replied calmly that my friend wanted his steak well done. When it arrived it was clearly rare so I sent it back and when it returned it was still rare in the middle. My friend told me not to worry and proceeded to eat it but later told me that it was the worst western meal.he had ever eaten. I appreciate that not all staff are ike that offensive waiter but where is their training? I bet the same waiter is still there and still causing offence? Where is their supervision? A thoroughly unproffesionaland unpleasant experience.
